messages:
Maria Chen: FYI — StratusBank just escalated. CISO says POC can't proceed without HSM-backed keys, region-restricted KG access, and a commercial indemnity clause. They want a pricing concession too. Can ops/security/execs weigh in?
Ethan Park: @Maria which KG are they using? Is this just demo data or will they upload sensitive data?
Maria Chen: They'll upload 2 months of anonymized transaction feeds for relevancy testing. They still consider it sensitive.
Jill Arora: HSM + region lock is doable in Private but not in Hosted without a dedicated plan. Need to confirm whether they want Private or Dedicated.
Ravi Singh: @Jill we can scope a temporary dedicated pool in eu-central-1 and attach a KMS-backed HSM key. Need estimate: 2x A100s for 4 weeks?
Anya Patel: Pricing note — if we offer a 20% pilot discount we need exec approval. This is strategic (financial reference), so recommend greenlight with clause: discount tied to 12-month commit.
Sam Ortiz: @Ravi I can prepare the infra runbook. Quick Q: will they require audit logs shipped to their SIEM?
Maria Chen: yes — they asked for syslog export + 90-day audit retention.
Jill Arora: Security checklist: export, HSM, VPC peering with restricted egress, RBAC. I can start the Sec questionnaire answers. Need legal to draft indemnity language.
DeployBot: Deployment request created — ticket INFRA-7892, assigned to Ravi Singh.
Ravi Singh: tagging timeline — I can provision infra by Wed if legal/contract and funding signoff are done by EOD Tue.
Anya Patel: @Legal can we get a quick review of the indemnity + data residency clause? Urgent.
Legal (Julia): looping in counsel, will provide redlines within 24 hours.
Maria Chen: Customer meeting Wed 10am GMT. Exec request: @Anya or @VP_sales to join for pricing signoff.
Anya Patel: I can join. Also proposing: conditional 15% pilot discount, convert to list price after commit or scale.
Sam Ortiz: I'll prep a demo environment snapshot and the export instructions.
Jill Arora: I'll upload SQ answers draft here: https://redwood.internal/secure/sq/stratusbank (wip).
Maria Chen: Great. Action items: Ravi infra by Wed, Legal redlines 24h, Jill sec answers by EOD, Anya on pricing. Let's triage blockers after legal update. :thumbsup: 
Ethan Park: Do we need an SLA? They asked for 99.9 for the POC — is that standard?
Anya Patel: For dedicated pilot we can promise 99.9 SLA; include in pilot letter.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — will update customer after legal. Marking as exec escalation.
DeployBot: Thread updated: INFRA-7892 -> in-progress. Last event by Ravi Singh.
